title: UI / UX Designer
description:
Design and develop high-quality, user-centered design concepts for web and mobile applications. 
 Conduct research to identify user needs and behaviors, informing design decisions. 
 Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs to communicate design ideas. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management, engineering, and marketing. 
 Develop and maintain design systems, style guides, and standards. 
 Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies in UI/UX design.
